roles.purpose: Primary proposal execution worker. Runs game tick simulation, stages saves, and generates ValidatorTask.
Independent validator worker. Loads staged proposals in read-only sandbox, runs census, and writes protected results.
roles.defect_summary: In current R23 WorkerBridge.cs line 443-445, SafeSaveDataFolderPath unconditionally returns WorkerUserDataDirectory regardless of active role. When the instance boots under READ_ONLY, tasks, staging, and saves still map to WorkerUserDataDirectory instead of ValidatorUserDataDirectory.

consumers.responsibility: Root property providing active UserData directory for all game and bridge file operations.
consumers.proposed_m04_logic: if (_activeStartupConfig != null) { bool isReadOnly = string.Equals(_activeStartupConfig.Role, "READ_ONLY", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase); string target = isReadOnly ? _activeStartupConfig.ValidatorUserDataDirectory : _activeStartupConfig.WorkerUserDataDirectory; if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(target)) return target; }

consumers.responsibility: Component startup logging of active configuration parameters.
consumers.proposed_m04_logic: Logs role-aware active UserData directory (ValidatorUserDataDirectory when Role == READ_ONLY, WorkerUserDataDirectory otherwise).
